info.title: GPU Box AI Worker
info.summary: Async research and writing-review jobs for the visualizer stack.
info.description: Runs on the RTX 3090 box and serves Akasha (research jobs) and Logos (LLM review jobs, and discussions of a review's issues). Callers never talk to Ollama or SearXNG directly. Every job is asynchronous: submit with POST /jobs, poll GET /jobs/{job_id}. The worker never initiates connections to callers and never accepts URLs to fetch from callers. Status: proposal, not implemented. Human-readable spec: README.md beside this file.

servers.description: Exposed over Tailscale Serve (HTTPS); reachable only from tailnet nodes allowed by ACL.

get.description: Returns 200 whenever the worker process is up; `ok` reflects its dependencies. Callers should use a short timeout (~2 s) and cache the result (~30 s).

macAsleep.summary: Box healthy, verifier (the Mac) asleep — jobs run, second check is skipped

post.summary: Submit a research, review or discussion job
post.description: Queues a job. Repeating a request with the same `Idempotency-Key` returns the original job with 200 instead of creating a new one; reusing a key with a different body returns 409.

get.summary: Get job state, progress, and result
get.description: Poll every 3–5 s while a user is watching; back off to 30 s otherwise. `result` is set only when `state` is `done`; `error` only when `failed`. Results are deleted at `expires_at`.

result.reply: A kettle of hot water is right for the period -- whisked tea needs it. It's the pouring into cups that reads as steeped tea. If she pours water over powder in a bowl, the scene works.
result.suggestion: Keep the kettle, but have her pour the water over powdered tea in her bowl.
result.replacement: lifted the kettle and poured hot water over the powdered tea in her bowl

delete.description: Cancels a `queued` or `running` job. Idempotent: cancelling a finished job returns it unchanged.

200.description: The job after cancellation (or unchanged if already finished).

post.summary: Fetch an image a research result found
post.description: Synchronous: the worker downloads the image now, with the same guarded fetcher research uses (public addresses only, re-checked after every redirect, size and type limits), and returns its bytes. Only URLs carrying their fetch_token are accepted. Callers pass the bytes to their own media handling; the worker keeps nothing.

200.description: The image bytes; Content-Type says which format (JPEG, PNG or WebP -- what Akasha stores).

post.description: Queues an `awaiting_approval` job again with the queries given; it keeps its place ahead of jobs submitted after it. To reject the plan, cancel the job.

bearerAuth.description: Shared secret (`WORKER_TOKEN`), configured on the worker and in the visualizer's `docker/.env` as `GPU_WORKER_TOKEN`.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Caller-chosen key (Akasha/Logos use their own job id). Strongly recommended so retries after network errors don't create duplicate jobs.

error.message: request.question must be at least 3 characters

IdempotencyConflict.description: `Idempotency-Key` reused with a different request body.

error.message: Key already used for a different request

PayloadTooLarge.description: Request exceeds the size limit (research 64 KB, review 1 MB, discussion 256 KB).

error.message: Review requests are limited to 1 MB

QueueFull.description: The queue is at its maximum size.

Unavailable.description: A dependency needed for this job kind is down (the message says which).

ImageUnavailable.description: The image could not be fetched: gone from its source, unreachable, too large, not a JPEG, PNG or WebP image, or at an address the worker refuses.

NotAwaitingApproval.description: The job is not waiting for its plan to be approved.

error.message: The job is running, not awaiting approval

code.description: API errors: invalid_request, unauthorized, not_found, idempotency_conflict, not_awaiting_approval (POST /jobs/{job_id}/plan only), payload_too_large, queue_full, unavailable, image_unavailable (POST /images only). Job failures (in Job.error): timeout, unavailable, no_sources, internal, plan_expired.

message.description: Human-readable; never contains prose or research content.

ok.description: True only when Ollama and SearXNG are both up (research needs both; review needs Ollama).

loaded.description: Models currently in VRAM. Empty means the first job pays a ~10–30 s load.

busy.description: True when another process (e.g. ComfyUI) holds most of the VRAM.

verifier.description: The optional second-check machine. Does not affect `ok` — research and review still run without it (unless a job sets verify=required).

JobState.description: queued → running → done | failed | cancelled. A research job asked with `approve_plan` stops at `awaiting_approval` after planning, until `POST /jobs/{job_id}/plan` queues it again (or it is cancelled, or its plan expires).

Client.description: Who submitted the job. No usernames or other personal data.

ref.description: The caller's own job id (also sent as Idempotency-Key).

question.description: With `refine.feedback`, the only writer text used to build search queries — never canon or manuscript text.

known_articles.description: Existing articles (refs and titles only — never bodies) so the worker can avoid duplicates and suggest links.

approve_plan.description: Stop after planning, in `awaiting_approval`, so the caller can edit or approve the search queries before any page is fetched.

blocks.description: Plain text per block, with stable ids so findings anchor to the manuscript.

references.description: Assembled by Logos: the chapter's Akasha references, deviations, the anachronism watchlist, and only verified research.

kind.description: Issues contradicting a `deviation` reference are suppressed.

DiscussionRequest.description: One issue from a review, and the writer's conversation with the editor about it so far. The caller keeps the conversation; the worker keeps nothing between jobs, so every turn sends it all again.

issue.description: The issue as the review reported it.

replacement.description: The exact replacement for quote the review offered, if any.

passage.description: The block the issue is about, as it reads now. It may have been revised since the review, so the issue's quote may no longer be in it.

reference.description: The article the issue is based on, sent as for a review; null for a prose issue, or when the article is no longer available to the writer.

messages.description: The conversation so far, oldest first; the editor replies to it.

role.description: writer: the person who wrote the chapter. editor: an earlier reply of the worker's.

expires_at.description: When the result is deleted (finished_at + RESULT_TTL_HOURS).

result.description: Set only when `state` is `done`. Shape depends on `kind`.

plan.description: Set once a job asked with `approve_plan` has planned; otherwise null.

stage.description: Research: loading_model, planning, searching, fetching, extracting, verifying, writing, second_check. Review: loading_model, reviewing, second_check. Discussion: loading_model, replying. second_check appears only when the optional verifier runs.

ResearchResult.description: Nested by design; flattening into Akasha's flat documents is the import module's job.

dropped_facts.description: Facts that failed verification — shown to the writer, never imported as facts.

reason.description: quote_not_found / no_citation / source_unreachable: first-pass checks on the box. unsupported: the second check judged the quotes don't support the fact.

body.description: Wikitext. Citations appear as `[[cite:<source key>]]` tokens, which Akasha rewrites to `[[sources/<slug>]]` on import.

image_candidates.description: Candidates only; importing is the writer's action. Empty unless `include_images` was true.

quote.description: Verified by the worker to appear verbatim in the fetched page text.

license.description: License as stated by the source; null if unknown.

fetch_token.description: Signed by the worker with a key only it holds: proof that this URL came from one of its own results. POST /images fetches a URL only when presented with its token, so callers can never make the box fetch an address of their choosing. Valid for as long as the key is (it does not expire with the job).

key.description: Local to this result (s1, s2, …). Akasha assigns slugs on import, deduplicating by normalized URL.

excerpts.description: Short verbatim passages supporting the article's facts — not full page copies.

ReviewIssue.description: Logos maps these onto the finding shape its RuleBasedWritingAdvisor already produces.

block.description: Id of the block the issue anchors to.

quote.description: Appears verbatim in the block; the worker drops issues whose quote it can't find.

replacement.description: The exact text to put in place of quote to make the fix, so the writer can accept it in one step; null when the fix is not a direct rewording of the quoted words. Never equal to quote.

reference.description: The reference the issue is based on; null for prose issues.

verified.description: true: the second check confirmed the issue. null: not second-checked (verification skipped or off). Issues judged not real are removed, not returned as false.

DiscussionResult.description: The editor's reply to the writer's last message.

stance.description: Where the editor now stands on the issue. maintains: it still holds. revises: it holds, but a different fix would serve better (see suggestion). withdraws: the writer has shown it is wrong, or that the passage is deliberate. The writer still decides the issue's status.

suggestion.description: A new minimal fix; only with stance revises, otherwise null.

replacement.description: The exact text to put in place of the issue's quote for the new fix; only with stance revises, and only when the fix is a direct rewording of the quoted words. Otherwise null.

VerifyMode.description: Optional second check on another machine (e.g. the M1 Max). auto: run it when the verifier is healthy, otherwise skip. required: fail the job with `unavailable` if the verifier is down. off: never run it.

Verification.description: Outcome of the optional second check.

status.description: checked: every item was second-checked. skipped: the verifier was unavailable (verify=auto) — results are first-pass only. off: the caller set verify=off or no verifier is configured.

model.description: Verifier model, e.g. bespoke-minicheck; null unless checked.

reason.description: Why the check was skipped or off; null when checked.

removed.description: Items removed by the check (research: moved to dropped_facts as unsupported; review: issues judged not real).

status.description: Second-check verdict on whether the cited quotes support the fact. Unsupported facts are moved to dropped_facts. unchecked when verification was skipped or off.

url.description: An image_candidates[].url from a research result.

size.description: preview: at most 360 px on the longest side, re-encoded as JPEG (PNG when the image has transparency) -- for showing candidates. full: the original bytes, up to the worker's IMAGE_MAX_BYTES -- for importing.

Plan.description: The search queries a research job will run. Built from the question (and, when refining, the writer's feedback and the previous facts) — never from canon.

approved.description: false while the job awaits approval.

expires_at.description: While awaiting approval: when the job fails with `plan_expired`. Null once approved.

queries.description: The plan as approved: the proposed queries, edited or not. Empty is allowed when refining — the job then re-reads only the previous sources.

Refinement.description: Revise an earlier draft. Its kept sources are fetched again and every quote re-verified against them, never trusted from here; new searches fill the remaining `max_sources`.

feedback.description: The writer's instructions. Shown to the planner, so it reaches search queries like the question.

exclude_urls.description: Pages never to read again, from search or from `previous`.
